AI Handler

AI model management and object tracking with YOLO and ByteTrack integration.

AI Handler Module.

This module manages model loading, object detection, and tracking functionality with ByteTrack. It provides the ModelManager class that handles YOLO model operations + ByteTrack object tracking, with functions for common operations.

The module integrates YOLO object detection with ByteTrack for persistent object tracking across video frames, running inference asynchronously to avoid blocking.

class ai_handler.TrackerArgs[source]

Bases: object

Configuration arguments for ByteTracker.

This class holds the configuration parameters for the ByteTrack object tracker. These arguments control tracking behavior including detection thresholds, track buffering, and matching sensitivity.

track_thresh

Minimum confidence threshold for tracking (0.25).

Type:

float

track_buffer

Number of frames to buffer lost tracks (30).

Type:

int

match_thresh

IoU threshold for track matching (0.8).

Type:

float

mot20

Whether to use MOT20 protocol (False).

Type:

bool

__init__()[source]
class ai_handler.ModelManager[source]

Bases: object

Manages models for object detection and tracking.

This class handles loading of YOLO models, running object detection inference, and maintaining a ByteTrack tracker instance for persistent object IDs across frames. All inference operations are designed to run asynchronously via thread pool executors to avoid blocking the async event loop.

object_detection_model

The loaded YOLO model instance.

Type:

YOLO

model_loaded

Flag indicating whether a model is loaded.

Type:

bool

tracker

ByteTrack tracker instance for object tracking.

Type:

BYTETracker

get_objects(image)[source]

Get detected objects with bounding boxes and metadata.

Runs object detection and formats the results into a list of dictionaries containing class information, confidence scores, and bounding boxes.

Parameters:

image (numpy.ndarray) – Input image as a NumPy array.

Returns:

List of detected objects, where each dict contains:

  • ’class’ (str): Object class name

  • ’class_id’ (int): Numeric class ID

  • ’confidence’ (float): Detection confidence score

  • ’bbox’ (list[float]): Bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2]

Return type:

list[dict]

proxy_bytetrack_update(detections_for_tracker, image_info)[source]

Proxy method for running ByteTrack update in a thread pool.

This synchronous method wraps the tracker’s update call, allowing it to be executed in a background thread via asyncio’s run_in_executor.

Parameters:

  • detections_for_tracker (numpy.ndarray) – Array of detections with shape (N, 6) containing [x1, y1, x2, y2, score, class_id].

  • image_info (tuple) – Image dimensions as (height, width).

Returns:

List of active tracks with updated positions and IDs.

Return type:

list[STrack]

proxy_predict(image, verbose)[source]

Proxy method for running YOLO prediction in a thread pool.

This synchronous method wraps the model’s predict call, allowing it to be executed in a background thread via asyncio’s run_in_executor.

Parameters:

  • image (numpy.ndarray) – Input image as a NumPy array.

  • verbose (bool) – Whether to print prediction information.

Returns:

List containing YOLO results.

Return type:

list[ultralytics.engine.results.Results]

async track_objects(image)[source]

Track objects across frames using YOLO detection and ByteTrack.

Combines YOLO object detection with ByteTrack tracking to maintain persistent object IDs across video frames. Runs inference and tracking in background threads to avoid blocking the async event loop.

Parameters:

image (numpy.ndarray) – Input image as a NumPy array.

Returns:

List of tracked objects, where each dict contains:

  • ’class’ (str): Object class name

  • ’class_id’ (int): Numeric class ID

  • ’track_id’ (int): Persistent tracking ID

  • ’confidence’ (float): Detection confidence score

  • ’bbox’ (list[float]): Bounding box as [x1, y1, x2, y2]

  • ’centre’ (list[float]): Box center as [cx, cy]

  • ’mask_polygon_norm’ (None): Placeholder for future mask support

Return type:

list[dict]
